pages.text: Back already, {player}? Good. The wild is waiting, and real mining starts there. Stone for building and tools, coal for fuel and torches.
Find a hillside or a cave in the survival world and swing that pickaxe. The &6Collections&r page in your K menu counts everything you gather. Stone and coal will tick up as you go.
Sixty-four stone and twenty-four coal will do nicely. Don't dig straight down. Everyone does it once.
